context: US population density dot map using rejection-sampled stipple technique, with hover interaction showing per-state stats
first_impression: A warm, print-inspired cartographic aesthetic with deliberate restraint, but the legend collides directly with Alaska's inset in the lower-left corner
what_works: The cream background (#f5f0e8) and semi-transparent near-black dots create a genuine print-map quality far above default D3 styling; dual stroke weights (0.6 internal / 1.2 national border) show real hierarchy in the cartographic chrome
what_doesnt: The legend is positioned absolute bottom-left 24px, which overlaps Alaska's AlbersUsa inset — a concrete layout bug that obscures both; typographic hierarchy is modest (20px title to 13px subtitle) with nothing to guide the eye from headline into the map itself
